lineage: Standard 52-card French deck folk cartomancy. Suit domains and card meanings follow the traditional shared folk system, written fresh for this corpus. Like Lenormand, this tradition reads in combination — pairs and chains carry the sentence.

cards.name: Ace of Hearts
cards.meaning: New love or deep affection blossoms; the heart finds its home.

cards.name: 2 of Hearts
cards.meaning: A lucky partnership; two hearts moving as one.

cards.name: 3 of Hearts
cards.meaning: Caution in matters of the heart; do not rush what is tender.

cards.name: 4 of Hearts
cards.meaning: Change stirs the heart; love may travel or transform.

cards.name: 5 of Hearts
cards.meaning: Jealousy clouds affection; clear the air before it festers.

cards.name: 6 of Hearts
cards.meaning: Harmony and good fortune; the heart rests easy.

cards.name: 7 of Hearts
cards.meaning: A promise bends or breaks; guard against disappointment.

cards.name: 8 of Hearts
cards.meaning: Visits and invitations; company comes bearing warmth.

cards.name: 9 of Hearts
cards.meaning: The wish card: a heartfelt dream comes true.

cards.name: 10 of Hearts
cards.meaning: Deep happiness and good luck; joy overflows.

cards.name: Jack of Hearts
cards.meaning: A fair, thoughtful young man; kind intentions.

cards.name: Queen of Hearts
cards.meaning: A fair, affectionate woman; warmth you can trust.

cards.name: King of Hearts
cards.meaning: A fair, good-natured man; honest counsel in love.

cards.name: Ace of Diamonds
cards.meaning: News of money or a valued gift; enterprise stirs.

cards.name: 2 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: Opposition in money matters; a clash of values.

cards.name: 3 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: Quarrels over money or papers; mind the fine print.

cards.name: 4 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: Steady financial gain; an inheritance or solid improvement.

cards.name: 5 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: Success in enterprise; prosperity shared.

cards.name: 6 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: A new venture begun; heed the warning in the accounts.

cards.name: 7 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: Gossip circles your finances; keep your own counsel.

cards.name: 8 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: Unexpected money arrives; a late reward.

cards.name: 9 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: A new business opportunity knocks; answer it.

cards.name: 10 of Diamonds
cards.meaning: Money in motion; travel or effort brings gain.

cards.name: Jack of Diamonds
cards.meaning: A clever but unreliable young person; verify before trusting.

cards.name: Queen of Diamonds
cards.meaning: A talkative woman; not all she says is gold.

cards.name: King of Diamonds
cards.meaning: A sharp man of business; deal boldly but wisely.

cards.name: Ace of Clubs
cards.meaning: Good news and wealth through effort; work bears fruit.

cards.name: 2 of Clubs
cards.meaning: Plans meet opposition; hold your ground.

cards.name: 3 of Clubs
cards.meaning: A fortunate union; ambition marries well.

cards.name: 4 of Clubs
cards.meaning: Change in work; stay alert for deceit.

cards.name: 5 of Clubs
cards.meaning: New friendships and alliances form around your work.

cards.name: 6 of Clubs
cards.meaning: Success in business; the enterprise prospers.

cards.name: 7 of Clubs
cards.meaning: Success won against opposition; persistence pays.

cards.name: 8 of Clubs
cards.meaning: Friction in work matters; labor through it.

cards.name: 9 of Clubs
cards.meaning: Achievement recognized; admiration follows effort.

cards.name: 10 of Clubs
cards.meaning: A journey for work; business travel succeeds.

cards.name: Jack of Clubs
cards.meaning: A loyal young friend; trust offered freely.

cards.name: Queen of Clubs
cards.meaning: A confident, capable woman; a strong ally.

cards.name: King of Clubs
cards.meaning: An honest, reliable man; sound judgment.

cards.name: Ace of Spades
cards.meaning: A powerful ending or transformation; intensity reshapes.

cards.name: 2 of Spades
cards.meaning: Deceit or separation; something divides.

cards.name: 3 of Spades
cards.meaning: Sorrow or parting; a difficult passage.

cards.name: 4 of Spades
cards.meaning: Small misfortunes or low spirits; rest and recover.

cards.name: 5 of Spades
cards.meaning: Success earned through struggle; the obstacle yields.

cards.name: 6 of Spades
cards.meaning: Improvement follows hardship; the road clears.

cards.name: 7 of Spades
cards.meaning: A loss or sorrow; grieve, then go on.

cards.name: 8 of Spades
cards.meaning: Unwelcome news or opposition; brace and respond.

cards.name: 9 of Spades
cards.meaning: The hardest card: deep loss or illness; endure with courage.

cards.name: 10 of Spades
cards.meaning: Worry weighs heavy; a confining situation.

cards.name: Jack of Spades
cards.meaning: A hostile or scheming young person; stay guarded.

cards.name: Queen of Spades
cards.meaning: A sharp, experienced woman; she has survived worse.

cards.name: King of Spades
cards.meaning: An ambitious, powerful man; respect his reach.
